_note: How an answer in Italian is compared (see sl.json for the fields). same: l' acqua is l'acqua (an apostrophe after a consonant is an elision; after a vowel it stands for an accent: perche'). fold: the accents (è for e, perchè or perche' for perché) are almost right, hint accent. loose: the apostrophe and the elided article (un amica for un'amica, la acqua or l acqua for l'acqua), ci and ne not elided before e (ci è for c'è, ci era for c'era, ce ne è for ce n'è) are almost right, hint apostrophe; lo or la before a form of avere only where the participle after it agrees (la ho vista for l'ho vista, lo ho visto for l'ho visto: almost; lo ho vista, la ho visto: the pronoun's gender wrong, wrong). wrong: the regular stem where a form has its own (anderò, averò, vederò, poterò for andrò, avrò, vedrò, potrò; ferò, sterò, derò for farò, starò, darò; mangierò, comincierò for mangerò, comincerò; the conditional's alike: anderei; venito, bevito, piacito for venuto, bevuto, piaciuto; B1's combined pronouns: the e of glie- left out, glilo, portaglilo, and the i kept before lo, la, ne on the end of a verb, dammilo, portamilo, darmilo for dammelo, portamelo, darmelo, each only for a glie- or -melo, -telo, -celo, -velo form (cavilo for cavolo, gagline for galline stay slips), as mi lo, ti la are wrong by their ending; the gerund with the other verbs' ending, leggando, dormando, bevando for leggendo, dormendo, bevendo, parlendo for parlando, and farendo, direndo, berendo for facendo, dicendo, bevendo; dicendoli, dandoli for dicendogli, dandogli, li for gli on a gerund; an article melted into di, da, in, a or su for another, B1's passive: della, alla or nella for dalla, delle for dalle, degli for dagli, only for another of them: della for bella stays a slip; B1's tenses and moods one letter off another's: the future's sarai, avrai, farai, darai for the conditional's sarei, avrei, farei, darei and the other way, the indicative's siamo and sta for the subjunctive's siano and stia, the remote past's fosti for the subjunctive's fossi and the other way, andò for the future's andrò, siete for siate; B2's imperfect subjunctive one letter off another's: desti, deste for dessi, desse and the other way, dissi, disse for dessi, desse, foste for fosse and the other way (dessi, fosse and the like are short enough to count as a slip otherwise), each only for that word; siano for siamo is left a slip, m and n side by side, for whoever hasn't met the subjunctive), matched against a word folded (no accents): wrong, never a slip in the stem. B1 too: glielo or gliela before avere is gliel', not elided almost only where the participle agrees, as lo and la (glielo ho dato, gliela ho data: almost; glielo ho data: wrong). B2 too: an adverb made without the rule, facilemente, regolaremente for facilmente, regolarmente, lentomente for lentamente, felicamente for felicemente; a prefix not assimilated, inpossibile, inregolare, inlegale, inbevibile for impossibile, irregolare, illegale, imbevibile; barcetta for barchetta; each only for a word of its kind (veremente for veramente stays a slip). ending_swaps: an ending typed for another on the same stem, where the subjunctive and the indicative differ a letter before the last two (dormono for dormano, dormano for dormono, parlano for parlino, parlate for parliate) and the conditional and the future (sarete for sareste): wrong, hint ending, never a slip in the stem; B2: the imperfect subjunctive with another conjugation's vowel, -assi, -essi, -issi and their -sse, -ssimo, -ssero, -ste (dormesse for dormisse, parlessi for parlassi, stassi for stessi, dasse for desse) likewise; a slip elsewhere in such a word stays one (bambeno, bambimo for bambino; bambano is a swap).
